title: Files API 3.0 for Unity Catalog volumes is now in Beta
body:
Files API 3.0 is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types) and introduces two new capabilities:

* **Multipart uploads:** Upload files larger than 5 GB to Unity Catalog volumes.
* **Conditional operations:** Upload, download, and delete files based on their current version to prevent unintended changes.

For more information, see [What is Files API?](/aws/en/volumes/files-api).
